'''Douglas R. Worsnop''' (born November 1, 1952) is an American [[atmospheric sciences|atmosphere]] and hydrospheric scientist, a significant figure in his field, currently at [[Aerodyne Research]] and an Elected Fellow of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.aaas.org/fellow/worsnop-doug |title=Doug Worsnop |publisher=aaas.org |accessdate=April 24, 2017 |archive-date=May 19, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170519090421/https://www.aaas.org/fellow/worsnop-doug |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.aerodyne.com/employees/douglas-r-worsnop |title=Douglas Worsnop |publisher=aerodyne.com |accessdate=April 24, 2017}}</ref> and the [[Finnish Society of Sciences and Letters]].<ref>{{Cite book |title=Societas Scientiarum Fennica SPHINX Yearbook 2019-2020 |publisher=The Finnish Society of Sciences and Letters |year=2020 |isbn=978-951-653-453-7 |location=Helsinki, Finland |pages=228}}</ref>  He graduated from [[Hope College]] and [[Harvard University]].<ref>https://cen.acs.org/articles/95/i1/ACS-Award-Creative-Advances-Environmental.html</ref>
